title: Inscription Social Protocol
tagline: Build a fast and efficient inscription social protocol based on Ethereum inscription technology and zk rollup technology. Using this set of protocols, users' social graphs can be renewed and displayed in various social applications.

prizes.placement: 🕸 The Graph — 🥇 Best Use of Subgraph or Substream
prizes.title: The Graph

description:
1. Inscription-based social protocols, the set of protocols needs to contain the user's social graph and support graph modification and retrieval functions.
2. application market platform, developers can publish all kinds of applications based on social protocols, so that users can go to all applications with one click.
3. Efficient social graph construction, updating and retrieval back-end services, supporting the overlay of recommendation services.
how_its_made:
1. Highly scalable inscription protocol
2. development of social graph maintenance system based on the graph
3. quality front-end application marketplace design
4. supports both chats and channel features to meet web3 social requirements.
5. Efficient social graph construction, updating and retrieval back-end services, supporting the overlay of recommendation services.
